toolchains.contents:
# NOTE: Homebrew's cargo (/opt/homebrew/bin/cargo) is a real binary, not a
# rustup shim, so it IGNORES this file. Always build through
# `tools/cargo.sh` does not exist in this repository. Invoke this exact
# toolchain through rustup when Homebrew cargo shadows the rustup shim.
[toolchain]
channel = "1.99.1"
components = ["rustfmt", "clippy", "rust-src"]

[workspace]
resolver = "3"
members = ["crates/*"]
# specimen-studio/ is a separate Cargo workspace (its own Cargo.toml, lockfile
# and gate). It stays excluded so this workspace's fmt/clippy/test gate does
# not build it. From this directory, `cargo studio` runs the desktop app and
# `cargo studio-build` builds it.
exclude = ["specimen-studio"]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.99"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/donaldfilimon/wdbx"

[workspace.dependencies]
abi-foundation = { path = "crates/abi-foundation" }
abi-telemetry = { path = "crates/abi-telemetry" }
abi-compute = { path = "crates/abi-compute" }
abi-core = { path = "crates/abi-core" }
abi-wdbx = { path = "crates/abi-wdbx" }

serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["preserve_order"] }
sha2 = "0.11"
jsonschema = { version = "0.58.4", default-features = false }
crc32fast = "1"
num-bigint = "0.5"
num-traits = "0.2"
thiserror = "2"
wyhash = "0.6"
zeroize = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["serde", "v4", "v5"] }
chacha20poly1305 = { version = "0.11", features = ["getrandom"] }
ed25519-dalek = "3"
tfhe = { version = "=1.8.1", default-features = false, features = ["boolean", "integer", "shortint"] }

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "deny"
missing_docs = "warn"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
module_name_repetitions = "allow"
missing_errors_doc = "allow"
missing_panics_doc = "allow"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"

limitations: Existing receipts are historical observed artifacts, not release acceptance.
Companion v5 original unavailable; inherited hash is not original bytes. Member-erasure revision 3 original available but explicitly unapproved.
All release rows remain proposed/C0 with empty evidence.
